SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.study_no AS studyNo, p.name, p.gender, p.age, p.card_no AS cardNo,
p.mobile, YEAR(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate)) AS createYear, COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate) AS createTime, p.follow_cycle AS followCycle, IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) AS visitCount, v.lastVisit, v.firstVisit, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NULL AND v.lastVisit IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) END AS nextDue, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'withdrawn' WHEN IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) = 0 THEN 'pending_first' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) < CAST(#{asOf} AS DATE) THEN 'overdue' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) <= DATE_ADD(CAST(#{asOf} AS DATE), INTERVAL 14 DAY) THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END AS followStatus FROM patient_basic_info p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND research_type IN () AND patient_id = #{patientId}) d ON d.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND miss = 1 AND research_type IN () AND patient_id = #{patientId}) w ON w.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS lastVisit, MIN(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS firstVisit FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.research_type IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ()) GROUP BY f.patient_basic_info_id) v ON v.pid = p.id WHERE p.id = #{patientId}
mapper.select:
SELECT x.patientId, x.studyNo, x.name, x.gender, x.age, x.cardNo, x.createYear, x.followCycle, x.visitCount, DATE_FORMAT(x.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.firstVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS firstVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.lastVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.nextDue, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextDueDate, x.followStatus FROM () x
ORDER BY x.lastVisit IS NULL, x.lastVisit DESC, x.patientId DESC ORDER BY x.studyNo IS NULL, x.studyNo ASC, x.patientId ASC ORDER BY x.createTime IS NULL, x.createTime DESC, x.patientId DESC

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, f.id AS visitId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.bqpg AS bqpg FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN #{id} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, f.bqpg AS bqpg FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.research_type IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT p.id FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE 1=1 )

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.fzjc AS fzjc FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN #{id} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT patient_id AS patientId, disease_code AS code, since_year AS sinceYear FROM patient_comorbidity WHERE patient_id IN #{id} ORDER BY patient_id, id

SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.mobile, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.nation, p.marry, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.confirm_date, p.confirmDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS confirmDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS happenDate, p.height, p.weight, p.waistline, p.xl, p.xy, p.xy_h AS xyH, p.xy_l AS xyL, COALESCE(p.acr_eular_score, p.acrEularScore) AS acrEularScore, p.smoke, COALESCE(p.smoke_years, p.smokeYears) AS smokeYears, COALESCE(p.smoke_count_by_day, p.smokeCountByDay) AS smokeCountByDay, COALESCE(p.smoke_stop, p.smokeStop) AS smokeStop, p.allergy, p.gms, p.jzs, p.jws, (SELECT CONCAT_WS('；', NULLIF(TRIM(r.reason), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(r.other_miss_reason), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(r.note), '')) FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.patient_id = p.id AND r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.miss = 1 AND r.research_type IN () ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS withdrawReason FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE p.id = #{patientId} AND p.id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ())
SELECT diagnosis_informed AS diagnosisInformed, consent_signed AS consentSigned FROM patient_ra_extra WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT f.id AS visitId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS visitTime, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName
, f.bqpg, f.bsbq, f.zlfa FROM patient_follow_up_history f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.doctor_id WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND research_type IN ()
SELECT card_no FROM patient_basic_info WHERE id = #{patientId}
